summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of Skyline Empire (Expo/React Native web preview @ 390x844) against live external backend (acquire-game.emergent.host). Home/Boardroom, Rules, Setup, and Game screens all load and render correctly. Core turn loop confirmed across 6+ full turns: human places tile -> Buy sheet -> buy-and-end/end-turn -> AI deliberating indicator -> AI founds/buys -> control returns to human. Buy flow with active chain works (buy-astor-inc stepper + buy-and-end reduced cash 6500->6300 and credited 1 share). Sabotage indicator (open-sabotage) appears on human turn and sabotage-sheet opens with target buttons (sabotage-player-1) shown. Resume from ledger opens correct game; delete removes a row; Session Not Found renders for a bad game id and nf-back returns to Boardroom. Founding by human, merger flow, tie sheet, payout sheet, rematch, and game_over/GameOverSheet were not reachable within test session (require specific board states) — best-effort attempted; nothing broke. No red-screen errors; no crashes; only benign React Native Web deprecation warning about props.pointerEvents.

issues: Section labels use CSS text-transform:uppercase (expected per problem statement). All contrast, spacing (8pt grid) and touch targets look correct on 390x844.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Likely emitted from an internal RN Web component; grep for pointerEvents={...} props in /app/frontend/src/components.

Playwright observed 2 concurrent DOM nodes with data-testid='home-local-play' briefly after navigating back from a game via game-back. Likely an Expo Router transition artifact where the previous screen remains mounted for a moment. Not blocking, but could confuse automated tests / accessibility.

action_items: Optional: silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN Web warning by migrating pointerEvents from a prop to style.pointerEvents in the offending component(s).
Investigate transient duplicate 'home-local-play' testID during Expo Router transition from /game/[id] -> / (mount/unmount timing).
Merger/tie/payout/rematch flows were not reached in this iteration due to board-state dependencies. Recommend adding a scripted seed or dev-only 'jump to merger' path for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GAME_API_URL with no default (fails fast). Good.
app/game/[id].tsx uses a mounted ref + stepping ref to drive AI sub-turns safely; timers cleaned up on unmount. Good.
TileRack/Board CELL width is computed from Dimensions.get('window').width at module load — will not reflow on rotation/resize on web. Acceptable for mobile-first.

All interactive elements have testID (hand-tile-<TILE>, buy-<chainId>, buy-<chainId>-inc/dec, buy-and-end, end-turn, found-<chainId>, sabotage-player-<id>, sabotage-chain-<id>, sabotage-peek, game-back, nf-back, resume-game-<id>, delete-game-<id>, etc.). Good testability.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all reachable flows passed; merger/rematch/founding-by-human not reached)

seed_data_creation: Created several games via the live backend by starting Local Play from the UI. These remain in the ledger and can be deleted from the Boardroom.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://memory-handoff.preview.emergentagent.com. Use mobile viewport 390x844. Backend is external live service at EXPO_PUBLIC_GAME_API_URL — do not run local backend. Ledger accumulates games; use delete-game-<id> to prune. Full turn loop is deterministic once AI moves. For merger/founding-by-human coverage, seed a deterministic game state via backend if possible; otherwise repeatedly play until board is dense enough to bridge chains.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issue found in this iteration.
